summary: Boyd Group Services Inc. filed a Form 6-K with a press release announcing the election of directors at its Annual General Meeting on May 13, 2026. This is a routine corporate governance disclosure, not a special situation. The filing reports voting results for each nominee, with all directors elected by large majorities. There are no deal terms, advisor appointments, or unusual events. As a foreign private issuer report under Rule 13a-16, it simply satisfies periodic reporting requirements.
